tickets.issue: VPN not connecting before client call

faqs.question: I cannot access my account.
faqs.answer: Verify your login credentials. If the issue persists, use the Forgot Password option.

faqs.question: VPN is not connecting.
faqs.answer: Restart your VPN client, verify MFA, and confirm your internet connection before raising a network ticket.
